div.div: طِحْنٌ Flour; (S, MA, K;) as also ↓ طَحِينٌ : (MA:) or ground wheat and the like; [or meal;] and sometimes the inf. n., ↓ طَحْنٌ , is used in this sense. (Msb.) Hence the prov., أَسْمَعُ جَعْجَعَةً وَلَا أَرَى طِحْنًا [I hear a sound of the mill, or mill-stone, but I see not flour]. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
